Specification: This module is a TLC support module for model checking the specification of LiveInternalMemory. It provides concrete replacements for the constant operators Send, Reply, and InitMemInt so that TLC can evaluate transitions involving the internal memory interface, and it also defines a liveness formula requiring every processor to be busy infinitely often. In addition, it defines a large PostCondition value describing a specific counterexample trace as a structured record containing action and state snapshots.
